newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle actively traded at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle actively traded at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade active. Slaughter steers and heifers steady with late last week.

Inquiry good, demand fairly good. Sales confirmed on 22,200 slaughter steers and 19,900 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 52,800 head confirmed including 12,900 head or about 24 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1300 lbs 63.00.
Dressed Basis Select and Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 100.00, pen at 103.00 for Choice and 97.00 for Select hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1125 lbs 63.00; pen Select with end Choice 61.50; pen mixed Commercial to Choice 1100 lb heifers and heiferettes 60.00.
Dressed Basis Pen Select and Choice 1040 lbs at 103.00 for Choice and 97.00 for Select, light weights (under 550 lbs) 20.00 less.
Week to date 52,800 last week 111,100 last year 12,500.
